observation: Fresh main now publishes and validates createdAt as durable mission reality, but AutonomousMissionStore.update() still allowed a caller to replace createdAt with any other non-empty string. The existing writer creates createdAt once at mission creation and never updates it, so the generic write boundary could violate its own provenance semantics.
changes: Reject update patches that attempt to change createdAt away from the persisted store-owned value.
Allow an explicit identical createdAt value for compatibility while preserving ordinary mission updates.
Add a focused regression proving the rejected patch leaves durable createdAt unchanged.

verification.pre_fix_source_contract_replay: EXPECTED FAIL: update guarded id and protocol immutability but accepted a different non-empty createdAt that passed validMissionShape().
verification.post_fix_contract_replay: PASS: createdAt drift is rejected before Object.assign/event append/persistence; an identical createdAt and ordinary fields remain accepted.
verification.focused_regression_contract: tests/autonomous-mission-created-at-write-integrity.test.mjs exercises rejection, durable non-mutation, and compatible same-value update.

truth_boundary: This cycle does not declare all mission ledgers append-only and does not authenticate a consistently rewritten mission document. It only preserves the creation timestamp ownership already implied by create() and the published durable timestamp contract.
